name: Social Insurance (Bảo hiểm xã hội)
authority: Law on Social Insurance 41/2024/QH15 art.33 and art.34 — 8% employee and 17.5% employer, on a salary capped at 20 times the statutory reference level (2,340,000, ceiling 46,800,000).
